optimizedDescription.value: Indexes multi-workspace code and specs into unified graph with collision-free identities, config-relative lookups, and cross-workspace resolution.

optimizedContext.value:
# Workspace Integration

## Rules

- Identity & lookup:
  - File/Document ID: `{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` (e.g. `core:src/index.ts`); project-global resources outside workspaces use `root:{projectRelativePath}`. Workspace `codeRoot` wins over `root:`.
  - `SymbolNode.id`: `{filePath}:{kind}:{name}:{line}:{column}`.
  - `SpecNode.workspace`: workspace name string (e.g. `core`, `_global`). Spec ID format: `{workspace}:{specPath}`.
  - `configRelativePath`: path relative to active `specd.yaml` directory (forward slashes, no leading `./`); supports unprefixed CLI file selectors.
- Discovery & Specs:
  - Discover code from `SpecdWorkspaceConfig.codeRoot`; `discoverFiles` returns root-relative paths, indexer applies workspace prefix.
  - Index specs directly via workspace `SpecRepository`: `repo.list()`, `repo.persistedStateHash()`, concatenate artifacts from `repo.artifact()` (`spec.md` first, then alphabetical), `repo.metadata()` (title, description), `repo.readPersistedDependsOn()`, `repo.readPersistedImplementation()`. No pre-computed CLI callbacks.
- Cross-workspace import resolution:
  - Pass 2 resolves relative imports within workspace; package imports via `packageName → workspaceName` (`LanguageAdapter.getPackageIdentity`); PHP qualified names globally. `SymbolIndex` holds all workspace symbols before Pass 2.
- Index contract:
  - `IndexOptions`: `projectRoot`, `workspaces: readonly ProjectWorkspace[]`, `graphConfig: ProjectGraphConfig`, `onProgress`, `chunkBytes`, `vcsRef`, `vcsRoot: string | null`. `specs` callback on `WorkspaceIndexTarget` removed.
  - `IndexResult`: includes `workspaces: readonly WorkspaceIndexBreakdown[]` (`name`, `filesDiscovered`, `filesIndexed`, `filesSkipped`, `filesRemoved`, `specsDiscovered`, `specsIndexed`).
- `.gitignore` handling:
  - `respectGitignore: true` + non-null `vcsRoot`: load root and nested `.gitignore`; gitignore exclusion has absolute priority over `excludePaths`.
  - Null `vcsRoot`: skip root `.gitignore`; MUST NOT probe VCS directory markers (`.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`).
  - `respectGitignore: false`: skip all `.gitignore` files; only `excludePaths` applies.

## Constraints

- `@specd/code-graph` depends on `@specd/core`.
- Single `.specd/code-graph.lbug` database per project.
- `discoverFiles` workspace-agnostic; indexer owns prefixing and `configRelativePath`.
- Spec resolution exclusively via `SpecRepository`; no filesystem fallback.
- File identity changes require full graph rebuild.
